question: A ainihin alaƙa da ƙididdiga ta lissafi, wata malamar yara ƙanana tana gudanar da gogewa ta koyo tare da yaran kamar haka: A ƙananan ƙungiyoyi, ta umurce su da su ɗauki sandunan filastisin guda biyu masu daidaitaccen adadi, su yi babbar ƙwallo da ɗaya, kuma su yi ƙananan ƙwallaye da ɗayan. question: Malami a makarantar sakandire na shekara ta biyu ya kammala sashin darasi kan lambobi haƙiƙa tare da ɗalibansa, kuma yana so ya tantance ko suna da ikon warware matsalolin da ba su da mafita a cikin rukunin lambobi masu ma'ana. Wace ce daga cikin waɗannan ayyukan auna za ta ba malamin damar samun bayani game da wannan?
answer_a: Neman tsayin alwatika mai-kamar-kamar mai-tsawon gefe 2
answer_b: Kimannta lambobin marasa tushe daga ƙasa da sama
answer_c: Nemo tushen murabba'i a kan layin lambobi, kana bayyana hanyar da aka yi amfani da ita
answer_d: Nemo tsawon gefunan alwatika mai kusurwa dama mai gefe biyu daidai wanda hypoténus dinsa ma'auninsa ya kai 2/sqrt(2)
